body.p: Squeak, squeak, squeak. There are naughty children among us. That's the kind of kid he was. He lived with his mother, with his father. He was a naughty boy. One moonlit night, at night, he says, audibly, to his mother: "Let' s go for a walk." His mother said: "It's night, people sleep at night, they don't walk at night. Sleep." "Oh, moonlight, go outside, mama. The sledes are visible, the trees are visible, let's go for a walk." The mother simply says, "If you want to go for a walk, go for a walk." This child put on a fur coat, took a hat in his hands, tied a belt, put on socks, went outside after all, went out. He went outside, on the road, one heard, he went. Then his staff can be heard creaking: "Pacha-chick, pacha-chick, pacha-chick, pacha-chick!" Yeah, that's how he left. That kid still hasn't come back. Therefore, the child must obey the adults, the father and mother. He mustn't do his own thing, he mustn't get his own way.
